usageNotes: Retrieves the configuration for a specific node within a registered PVE remote in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. Use this to inspect per-node settings (e.g., address, fingerprint, capabilities) for a remote cluster node. Requires the Resource.Audit privilege on the remote/node ACL path; the remote must already be registered in PDM.

examples.summary: Fetch config for node 'pve1' on the remote named 'hetzner-cluster'

tips: The 'node' path param accepts 'localhost' as a special value to reference the local node of the remote.
Returns null (empty body) per the spec — the actual node config data is embedded in the HTTP response payload; check for a non-error status code rather than parsing a typed return value.
Remote IDs must be 2–32 characters and match [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]* — avoid spaces or special characters when registering remotes.
